## Distribution of the PFAS (raw values)
```{r distribution of the PFAS}
data1 <- data %>% 
  mutate_at(.vars = pfas_name,
         .funs = ~exp(.))

data_l <- data1 %>% select(pfas_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = pfas_name)

data_l %>% ggplot(aes(x = value )) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(.~name, scale = "free", nrow = 4)
```

## Distribution of the PFAS (lg2 transformed)
```{r distribution of the PFAS lg2}

data_l <- data %>% select(pfas_name) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = pfas_name)

data_l %>% ggplot(aes(x = value )) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(.~name, scale = "free", nrow = 4)
```

## Data summary {.tabset}
### Data summary for overall HCC data
```{r pfas summary for hcc data only after adding missing, results = 'asis'}
table1::table1(~.|status, data_hcc %>% select(status, all_of(pfas_name), blood_age, bmi_cat, alcohol_intake_cat,smokestatus, diabetes, eth, studyarea, sex, year_between))
```

### Data summary for NAFLD related HCC data
```{r pfas summary for NAFLD related HCC data after adding missing}
table1::table1(~.|status, data_nafld_hcc  %>%select(status, pfas_name, blood_age, bmi_cat, alcohol_intake_cat,smokestatus, diabetes, eth, studyarea, sex, year_between))

```

### Data summary for other HCC data
```{r pfas summary for other HCC after adding missing}
table1::table1(~.|status, data_other_hcc  %>%select(status, pfas_name, blood_age, bmi_cat, alcohol_intake_cat,smokestatus, diabetes,eth, studyarea, sex, year_between))
```

### Data summary for overall HCC data 
```{r pfas summary for hcc data split by ethnicity,results='asis'}
data_hcc %>% select(blood_age, status, eth, bmi_cat, alcohol_intake_cat, smokestatus, diabetes, studyarea, sex, year_between) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = status,
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = list(
                               all_continuous() ~ c("{mean} ({sd})",
                                                    "{median} ({p25}, {p75})"),
                               all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  add_n()
```
